none: PAS NLM-4E337A: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), irregular copy of a Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Weakly struck and worn. Obverse description: Bust probably helmeted left. Reverse description: Globe on altar. Reverse inscription: [BEATA TRANQVILLITAS]. Diameter: 14.9mm, Weight: 0.90gms, die axis: 6
